## Summary

Describe the change and its operator/system outcome.

## Validation

List tests, checks, and manual review performed.

## UI Governance

Complete for every UI-affecting pull request. Use `None` when a category does
not apply.

```text
Components:
- CMP-#### | None

UX Decisions:
- UXD-#### | None

Acceptance Record:
- UAR-#### | None

Exceptions:
- EXC-#### | None
```

- [ ] Every referenced record exists and has an accurate status.
- [ ] Reusable components have detailed registry records.
- [ ] No expired exception is used.
- [ ] Acceptance records match the implementation version.
- [ ] UI dates and times follow UXD-0003.
- [ ] Product-facing appearance terminology follows UXD-0001.
- [ ] Related governance records reference one another where practical.
